name: iPhone App 控制通道
description:
## 用途

模拟 iPhone App 查询 Mac 上的 Git 项目和 Codex 会话，并在新会话或已有会话中启动 Turn。当前无鉴权，只能连接可信局域网 Relay。

## App 可发送

- `project.list`
- `thread.list`
- `turn.start`
- `turn.interrupt`

## App 可接收

- `agent.hello`、`agent.status`
- `project.snapshot`、`thread.snapshot`
- `turn.started`、`turn.output`、`turn.snapshot`
- `turn.completed`、`turn.failed`、`turn.interrupted`、`turn.rejected`

## 第一步：查询项目

```json
{
  "spec_version": "2.0",
  "message_id": "11111111111141118111111111111111",
  "type": "project.list",
  "occurred_at": "2026-08-10T02:20:00Z",
  "trace_id": "22222222222242228222222222222222",
  "sender": { "kind": "user", "id": "apifox" },
  "payload": {}
}
```

从 `project.snapshot.payload.projects` 复制一个 `id`。

## 第二步：查询会话

```json
{
  "spec_version": "2.0",
  "message_id": "33333333333343338333333333333333",
  "type": "thread.list",
  "occurred_at": "2026-08-10T02:20:02Z",
  "trace_id": "44444444444444448444444444444444",
  "sender": { "kind": "user", "id": "apifox" },
  "payload": { "project_id": "project_xxx" }
}
```

## 第三步：启动 Turn

新会话省略 `thread_id`；继续会话时填入 `thread.snapshot` 返回的 ID。

```json
{
  "spec_version": "2.0",
  "message_id": "55555555555545558555555555555555",
  "type": "turn.start",
  "occurred_at": "2026-08-10T02:20:05Z",
  "trace_id": "66666666666646668666666666666666",
  "sender": { "kind": "user", "id": "apifox" },
  "payload": {
    "project_id": "project_xxx",
    "prompt": "检查当前修改并运行相关测试，不要提交代码"
  }
}
```

Relay 会按连接端点覆盖 `sender`。协议只接受 `2.0`，不兼容 `1.0 run.*`。
